text:
deploy-bot: starting canary window now. Plan: API=2.4.2, Runtime=3.14-beta (new kernel batching), Router=2.7-beta, Console=1.10. Canary sequence: 5% edge-region (us-west) -> 25% global if green. /cc @Sam @Maya

Sam: quick heads-up: router 2.7-beta increased connection churn in our perf sandbox yesterday. Might show up at the edge.

Maya: console 1.10 has a new realtime panel that backfills metrics; saw increased ingest pressure in load tests. Could amplify router issues.

Todd: ops asked to avoid exposing beta router to EU until we validate. Recommend US-only canary first.

Ingrid: release note draft: "Runtime 3.14-beta: experimental kernel batching; includes kv-cache heuristics." Will include fallback instructions.

deploy-bot: pausing full rollout. Adjusting: switch canary target to US-only 2% for API+Runtime. Router & Console -> hold.

Sam: agree with hold. We can promote API+Runtime and keep router on 2.6.x for now. That reduces surface area.

Maya: will toggle console feature flags so dashboard realtime panel is disabled during this window. config path: `/cfg/features/console/realtime=false`

Todd: ops-runner, please pin router to 2.6.18 in the cluster groups for this window.

ops-runner: pinned router=2.6.18 in prod-edge groups. Will watch connection_retries and tcp_reset rates.

deploy-bot: new canary: 2% US-only for API+Runtime. Monitoring hooks: per-route p95/p99, tcp_reset_rate, kv_cache_evictions, console_ingest_lag. Canary length 20m.

(6m) Sam: p95 looks stable, p99 for some long-tail routes nudged +40ms. tcp_reset_rate unchanged.

(12m) Todd: ops: noticing a small uptick in ephemeral connections in us-west nodes, but not out of normal. No action yet.

(18m) Maya: console ingest lag stable after feature flag. Panels OK.

(20m) Sam: canary green for API+Runtime. Promoting to 25% global except EU. 

Ingrid: rollback criteria proposed: 
- Any route p99 > 400ms sustained for 10m, OR
- Error rate > 2% for 5m, OR
- kv_cache_evictions > 15/min for 5m.
If triggered -> immediate pause and `deploy rollback --service runtime --version 3.13 --reason "canary breach"`.

ops-runner: verified rollback job exists and tested in staging. `ops rollback-job runtime 3.13` returns success; rollback ETA ~3m under load.

deploy-bot: promoted to 25% global (EU excluded). Attaching monitors: @slo-watch, @pagerduty.

(25m) Sam: small cluster of errors at +22m on a specific route (seq-gen). Error rate peaked 1.2% for 3m, then fell back. Not a breach.

(35m) Todd: network counters stable. No tcp resets.

(45m) Maya: console team confirms realtime panel stays disabled and dashboards nominal.

(50m) Sam: overall pass. Recommend scheduling Router+Console wave in next minor window with separate smoke test plan.

Ingrid: I'll publish release notes: callout that Router/Console held for stability, runtime change limited to API surface for now, fallback path available.

release-wg: noted. Scheduling follow-up wave for router+console next Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC. Sam/Todd to lead compatibility run.

deploy-bot: closing thread  API v2.4.2 and Runtime 3.14-beta rolled to 25% global (no EU). Router/Console deferred. Follow-up wave scheduled. :white_check_mark:

Sam: thanks everyone. I'll post a short postmortem if any late regressions appear.

Maya: adding a note to the console release checklist about feature-flag gating during infra-sensitive rollouts.

Todd: ops will run an extra canary against edge proxies before router promotion.

ops-runner: will keep a 2h extended watch on connection metrics. ping me for immediate rollback. :)
